shared_elements: procession of standing human figures in profile facing the same direction
low relief frieze bounded by a horizontal band of rosettes
figures wearing head coverings/headdresses and long belted garments
figures carrying objects (bowls/vessels) in the hands
ground line at the base of the figures
justification: Both show a low-relief procession of profile human figures in long belted robes and distinctive headgear walking in the same direction and carrying bowl-like vessels, framed by a horizontal band of identical multi-petalled rosettes above (and below in B) — a highly specific conventional scheme with the same rendering of hands, beards and drapery folds. The main difference in depicted content is that B includes a large camel led by a figure with a lead-rope, while A instead ends with a frontal-robed figure clasping the hand of the lead tribute-bearer.
